label: Kirby
header:
# Kirby municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 12; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Kirby's three selectboard members as Michael Bickford, Jeffrey Hayes, and Keith Isham (Chair)
Town of Kirby (official website), Government page: the Selectboard is Keith Isham (Chair, term to 2027), Michael Bickford (2029), and Jeffrey Hayes (2028)
Town of Kirby (official website), Government page: Michael Bickford is styled '(Road Commissioner, 2029)' on the Selectboard listing
Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): 'Town Officials' table: a separate Road Commissioner row names Michael Bickford

Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): 'Town Officials' table: John McClaughry is Moderator. His re-election at the March 3, 2026 meeting -- his 60th consecutive year in the office -- was reported by VTDigger's town meeting results coverage and WCAX (newspaper-class evidence, disclosed on issue #163)
Town of Kirby (official website), Government page: Erin Patoine is Town Clerk/Treasurer (term to 2027)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Erin Patoine as Kirby's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Erin Patoine as Kirby's town clerk contact
Town of Kirby (official website), Government page: Erin Patoine is Town Clerk/Treasurer (term to 2027)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Erin Patoine as Kirby's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Erin Patoine as Kirby's town treasurer contact
Town of Kirby (official website), Government page: the Listers are Marla Waring, Merle Thompson, and Mike Wood, each shown to 2028
Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): 'Town Officials' table: Listers Michael Wood, Marla Waring, and Merle Thompson, each to 2028

Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): 'Town Officials' table: Auditors Emily Hartsock (term to 2027), Leslie Peters (to 2028), and Cheryl McMahon (to 2026). The Warning for the March 3, 2026 meeting (Article 4) stood a three-year auditor seat; no official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so McMahon's seat is left unfilled

Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): the Warning for the March 3, 2026 meeting (Article 4) elects a Delinquent Tax Collector; the 'Town Officials' table's 'Tax Collector' (Erin Patoine) held a term expiring 2026 and the 2026 outcome is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): the Warning for the March 3, 2026 meeting (Article 4) elects an Agent to Convey Town Real Estate; the 'Town Officials' table records the office held by the Selectboard collectively in 2025, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): the Warning for the March 3, 2026 meeting (Article 4) elects a Trustee of Cemetery Funds; the 'Town Officials' table names Erin Patoine with a term expiring 2026 and the 2026 outcome is unpublished, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Kirby, 2025 Town Report (official town website): the Warning for the March 3, 2026 meeting (Article 4) elects a Sexton; the 'Town Officials' table records the office held by the Selectboard collectively in 2025, so the post is created without a membership

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names five justices of the peace for Kirby: Timothy Peters, Flower Toomey, Tracy Sherbrook, Karen Moore, and Anne McClaughry

Town of Kirby (official website), Government page: the 'Justices of the Peace' block names the same five: Karen Moore, Timothy Peters, Tracy Sherbrook, Anne McClaughry, and Flower Toomey. Anne McClaughry is a different person from Moderator John McClaughry; no relationship is asserted
